mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/pptx-text-box.test.ts:positioned text boxes execute23 saved outcomes and atomic refusals
outcomes: The wrapper reports no failures and 23 passed examples. Pinned bindings verify shape receipt/identity, EMU geometry, normalized paragraphs, direct flags and noAutofit after byte reopen; custody checks retain existing slide source and other payloads. Refusals retain archive bytes and slide version.
gaps: Only two aggregate assertions occur in this declaration; semantic checks are delegated to the pinned bindings. Positive cases use byte reopen, no path save. Custody checks use the live package rather than the reopened presentation; refusal codes are constrained to PPTX_ or XML_ prefixes, not individual codes. No rendering or geometric fit comparison.
Bounded source mapping only; direct versus deferred assertions and dynamic review flags are retained. Runtime leaf count is unknown; no new execution or rendering credit.

gaps: Native finite identity matrix; 0001 numerically collides with the existing root ID, so its refusal does not establish a blanket leading-zero policy. Receipt IDs are checked live, without output reopen or geometry checks.
